name: Dragon King Hot Pots

features.name: Smoke anticipation
features.description: Scatters make the dragon stir a pot.

review:
A fiery Asian 5x3 with lucky 8s. A dragon watches over four pots above the reels, worth 5x, 20x, 250x and 2,500x.

Any scatter makes the dragon blow smoke and a pot shakes in anticipation. Three scatters (or one or two with a random chance) start the Dragon Mini Slots, where matching sets of 8s pay instant cash until the feature ends. 96.54% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
